gancho: Pele, the goddess of the volcano, was not born in Hawaiʻi. She learned fire at her mother's hearth in far-away Kahiki, angered her sister Nāmaka of the sea, and had to flee in a great canoe, with her baby sister inside an egg. Season Two of Hawaiian mythology begins. Based on N. B. Emerson, Pele and Hiiaka (1915), and W. D. Westervelt, Hawaiian Legends of Volcanoes (1916).
